summary: Tests-only (red-phase) run for issue #5: generated OpenAPI client contract committed as a new Swift test target plus LID docs. Wrote 20 stub-based tests pinning the generated-client surface (module ColorMatchingOpenAPI, 6 operations) and the APIClient facade contract (generated result types, typed APIError cases, preserved wire shape). Contract-delta analysis between docs/color-matching-api-contract.md and the published spec (viamin/color_matching#110, verified live upstream: api_spec.ex, api_schemas.ex, controllers, TestSheetJSON renderer) committed as PR-body source material. Red phase is by design: the generated module and Package.swift wiring land in the implementation run, so the new tests cannot compile or execute here; additionally this container has no Swift toolchain, so swift test --disable-sandbox could not be run at all (environment limitation, not a test failure).

acceptance_criteria.description: swift-openapi-generator + swift-openapi-runtime added to the iOS package; OpenAPI document fetched/vendored from viamin/color_matching#110
acceptance_criteria.reason: Red phase: package wiring and vendoring are implementation-run work. Compile-time verification is committed: GeneratedClientTests imports ColorMatchingOpenAPI / OpenAPIRuntime / OpenAPIURLSession and constructs the generated Client with URLSessionTransport, so the criterion turns green exactly when the packages and vendored document exist. Upstream dependency confirmed satisfied: viamin/color_matching#110 is closed and serves GET /api/v1/openapi.json (verified via GitHub API).

acceptance_criteria.description: Generate the client for the surfaces the app uses today: test-sheet manifest + recent sheets, capture session creation, measurement upload, judgment upload, ranked results
acceptance_criteria.reason: Red phase: one stubbed round-trip test per operation (manifest also covers wire GET/Accept and documented 404 case). Tests fail to compile until the generated client exists; then they exercise each of the six operations against local stubs.

acceptance_criteria.description: Replace hand-written API models with generated types; keep purely client-side models as-is
acceptance_criteria.reason: Red phase: facade tests force the swap at compile time (createCapture/uploadMeasurements/uploadJudgments/fetchRecentSheets/fetchRankedResults return generated result types; old APIError.badStatus replaced by typed cases) while pinning that client-side SheetManifest and MeasurementCore domain models are kept. Replacement/retention scope is enumerated in the test plan.

references.note: generated MeasurementUploadResponse result + preserved wire shape
typed APIError from documented error body

acceptance_criteria.description: Swift tests exercising the generated client against local stubbed responses (no live server in CI)
acceptance_criteria.reason: Tests are written and committed, and are stub-only by construction (every request is served by StubbedURLProtocol; no network I/O). They could not be executed in this run: the generated module does not exist yet (implementation run adds it) and this container has no Swift toolchain (swift: command not found), so no execution evidence exists yet. Execution evidence is due from the implementation run via swift test --disable-sandbox.

acceptance_criteria.description: PR description records contract deltas between docs/color-matching-api-contract.md and the real API, plus endpoint gaps
acceptance_criteria.reason: The PR body is published when the implementation run opens the PR (this tests-only run does not push or open a PR). The required analysis is complete, evidence-backed against upstream source (api_schemas.ex, controllers, TestSheetJSON, router at viamin/color_matching@main), and committed for direct inclusion: 15 numbered schema deltas plus an endpoint-gap table.

acceptance_criteria.description: swift test --disable-sandbox green with generated types wired in
acceptance_criteria.reason: Exit criterion for the implementation run. Not runnable in this environment: no Swift toolchain installed and the generated target is not wired into Package.swift (off-limits in the tests-only phase). Baseline suite state is preserved: no existing test files were modified, and the new test directory is inert until Package.swift declares the ColorMatchingOpenAPITests target.
